comparison.objective: Swap a failed optical transceiver while retaining required caps, versus commissioning a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Latch/cage extraction and keyed module insertion versus recessed setscrew tooling, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and torque-limited relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct capped transceiver replacement is title-implied; body/specs and force thresholds are absent. Candidate instead validates two physical impact cycles and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Module replacement and cap management do not test iterative damping adjustment or dynamic-response verification.
